2607.21201.title: Bound-Founded Semantics for Answer Set Programming with Difference Constraints: Preliminary Report
2607.21201.paper_summary: While the integration of linear constraints has significantly expanded the reach of Answer Set Programming (ASP), existing hybrid solvers often rely on disparate semantic underpinnings that lack a unified logical foundation. We address this gap by introducing a many-sorted variant of the Bound-founded Logic of Here-and-There (HTb), providing a versatile framework capable of characterizing equilibrium models across a wide spectrum of alternative semantics for extensions of ASP with linear constraints. We apply this framework to the setting of difference constraints, focusing on the semantic characterization of clingo[DL]. Central to our approach is the formalization of foundedness for numeric variables. By investigating how different hybrid systems - such as clingo[DL], clingcon, and flingo - justify constraint atoms, we uncover the semantic roots of their varying behaviors. This investigation results in a single, consistent framework that not only formalizes the foundations of current systems like clingo[DL] but also facilitates the rigorous study of program simplifications and the future integration of diverse semantic principles.
2607.21201.paper_summary_zh: 雖然線性約束的整合顯著擴展了答案集程式設計（ASP）的應用範圍，但現有的混合求解器往往依賴於缺乏統一邏輯基礎的不同語義基礎。我們通過引入一種多排序的界限基礎邏輯（HTb）變體來解決這一差距，提供了一個多功能框架，能夠在廣泛的替代語義範疇內表徵具有線性約束的ASP擴展的平衡模型。我們將這一框架應用於差異約束的設定，專注於clingo[DL]的語義特徵化。我們方法的核心是對數值變量的基礎性進行形式化。通過研究不同混合系統（如clingo[DL]、clingcon和flingo）如何證明約束原子，我們揭示了它們行為差異的語義根源。這一調查結果形成了一個單一且一致的框架，不僅形式化了當前系統（如clingo[DL]）的基礎，還促進了對程式簡化的嚴謹研究以及未來多樣語義原則的整合。
